item: Studio Checks tab in plain words (Spencer, 2026-11-02): every problem and failed requirement as a card a non-engineer understands at a glance (which part, what is wrong in one sentence, why it matters, what fixes it; the raw check text folded under "details"), and a work status per card: "being fixed" (a Studio fix / edit job running, or a fresh claim naming the project) or "nobody on it" with the Fix button; rules in a new kerf/explain.py so the CLI and review pack can use them; tests
